name: Answer out loud
pick: People answer questions out loud in their own words: spontaneous speech, opinions, descriptions, short interviews.
summary: Answer short questions out loud, in your own words.
suggest: Answers of up to one minute
examples: let them talk up to a minute

prompts: Where did you go on your last holiday?
What do you like to do on holiday?
Describe a beautiful place you have visited.

settings.consent: I agree that my recordings and the information I give are stored and used to build a speech dataset for research.
settings.title: Answer a few questions out loud
settings.instructions: Find a quiet place. Read each question, then answer it out loud in your own words, as if you were talking to a friend. There are no wrong answers.
prompts: What did you do last weekend?
Describe the room you are in right now.
What is your favourite meal, and why?
How do you usually get to work or school?
